items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I still haven't found out who Mr. Pincus was.

ctx.x: This is the publishing house Mills?

That's right. And so I did go to the office, and I asked for Mr. Pincus. They said okay, just wait a minute. So I waited for quite a long time. I had an appointment with Gladys and Claude the same day and I had to leave. And so when I met Gladys and Claude, well the first thing that they did was handed me a contract to sign. By that time, Mr. Pincus had just lost the ball game. But anyway, I evidently beat the letter to
